assessments.title: Occupancy conflict semantics preserve omission and layering
assessments.classification: Bounded source nonfinding, related to Q1749 but not resolution
evidence: fit.rs:35–45 compares location and channel, then singleton channel or equal order, then omitted fit_zone or equal explicit zones. schema.rs:160–180 defines singleton channels, 183–199 makes omitted zone a default. occupancy.rs:104–112 checks zone fits location when the individual entry can decode.
assessments.conditions: An absent zone reserves the whole location only after location/channel and singleton/order predicates match. Disjoint explicit zones need not conflict. Helper does not prove allocation choices, parent graph correctness, all ingress paths or policy adequacy.
assessments.future_direction: Examine actual parent selection, persisted identity and allocator consumers before assigning an overlap defect.

assessments.classification: Historical rig CONTRACT-046 corroborated in newly read 95e source, no duplicate count
evidence: occupancy.rs:100–103 converts to typed requirement with .ok(); fit checks at 104–108 and conflict checks at 118–133 depend on conversion success, while order fallback at 114–117 is separate. validation.rs:269–273 records final typed ItemCatalogDocument mismatch.
assessments.conditions: Only the shown diagnostic-checked compiler route is established. The raw DTO can exist independently; no actual invalid value or runtime bypass has been demonstrated.

nonfindings: Omitted fit zone and nonarmor absent or empty surface are explicit allowed modes in the shown checks and must not be globally recast as malformed.
